description: This file contains constants, type definitions, and functions related to synchronization, events, date/time formats, and configuration for the Notesnook project.

methods.name: checkSyncStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously checks the synchronization status for a given event type using the EventManager.

methods.name: sendSyncProgressEvent
methods.description: Publishes a synchronization progress event with the current progress.

methods.name: sendMigrationProgressEvent
methods.description: Publishes a migration progress event with collection, total, and current progress.
